datasets.title: Tunisia - Impact des feux de forêts le 01 août 2021, gouvervorats de Jendouba et Le Kef, Tunisie
datasets.description: UNOSAT code: FR20210729TUN Cette carte illustre les zones d'incendies observées à partir d'une image satellite PlanetScope acquise le 01 août 2021, au sud-ouest de la ville de Ghardimaou. Dans les 9,700 ha de zone analysée, environ 530 ha et 2,100 ha de végétation semblent avoir brûlé dans les délégations de Ghardimaou et Sakiet Sidi Youssef. Ceci est une analyse préliminaire et n'a pas encore été validée sur le terrain. Ne pas hésiter à envoyer vos commentaires au Centre Satellitaire des Nations Unies (UNOSAT).. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/impact-des-feux-de-forets-le-01-aout-2021-gouvervorats-de-jendouba-et-le-kef-tunisie]
datasets.details: This is a preliminary assessment and has not yet been validated in the field. It is important to consider the characteristics of the source imagery used in the analyses when interpreting results. For damage assessments it should be noted that only significant damage to the structural integrity of the buildings analyzed can be seen in imagery, while minor damage such as cracks or holes may not be visible at all. For flood extractions using radar data it is important to note that urban areas and highly vegetated areas may mask the flood signature and result in underestimation of flood waters. Users with specific questions or concerns should contact unosat@unitar.org to seek clarification.

lineage.description: UNOSAT analysts compared PlanetScope satellite imagery acquired on 01 August 2021 with reference imagery to identify burned vegetation areas in southwestern Ghardimaou. Burned polygons were delineated and quantified by area (hectares) across the two affected delegations. This represents a preliminary post-event damage assessment based on remote sensing observation without field validation.

sources.name: UN Operational Satellite Applications Programme (UNOSAT)
sources.description: Satellite imagery analysis using PlanetScope data acquired 01 August 2021 to detect and map post-event wildfire extent and burned vegetation areas through multi-temporal image comparison
